page.title: Response policies
page.empty: No response policies match the current filters.
page.forbiddenText: You do not have permission to view response policies.
page.loadFailedText: Something went wrong while loading response policies. Try again.

filters.kindHint: Filter policies by response or cadence type.
filters.recordHint: Filter by the CRM record type covered by the policy.
filters.branchHint: Filter by tenant default or a specific branch override.
filters.stateHint: Filter between active and retired policy versions.

modal.discardText: You have unpublished changes to this policy. Closing now will discard them.

form.nameEnHint: English display name shown in policy lists and SLA reports (1 to 120 characters).
form.nameArHint: Arabic display name shown when the portal language is Arabic (1 to 120 characters).
form.kindHint: First response and follow-up cadence apply to leads; next step applies to leads or opportunities.
form.recordHint: Record type evaluated by this policy. Opportunities support next step only.
form.branchHint: Tenant default applies to all branches unless a branch-specific override exists.
form.clockKindHint: Working minutes follow the branch working calendar; follow-up cadence always uses calendar minutes.
form.targetHint: Response threshold duration. Working days equal 8 working hours (480 minutes); calendar days equal 24 hours.
form.requiredTouchCountHint: Number of qualifying touches required within the cadence window (1 to 50).
form.compliancePctHint: Minimum percentage of records meeting the cadence requirement (greater than 0 up to 100).
form.qualifyingTouchByHint: Choose whether only the record owner's actions count or actions by any team member.
form.activityTypesHint: Select activity types that satisfy this policy. Leave empty to allow all types.
form.directionsHint: Select activity directions that qualify. Leave empty to allow any direction.
form.touchSourcesHint: Select the event sources counted toward this policy. Leave empty to allow all sources.
form.effectiveFromHint: Date when this version takes effect. Policies cannot be backdated before today.
form.stateHint: Active policies are evaluated on new records; retired policies stop new evaluations.

meta.versionHint: Sequential version number inside this policy lineage.
meta.startEventHint: Record event that starts the SLA timer.
meta.qualifyingFactHint: Evidence type that satisfies this policy.
meta.supersedesHint: Previous version replaced when this version is published.

clock.branchHint: Branch whose published working calendar is used to compute the deadline.
clock.fromHint: Start date and 24-hour time for the clock simulation.
clock.minutesHint: Positive number of working minutes to add from the start instant.
clock.deadlineHint: Computed due date and time, or the reason the branch calendar cannot compute it.

missing.CALENDAR_UNAVAILABLE: No working calendar for this branch
missing.CALENDAR_HOURS_MISSING: Working hours are missing for this branch
missing.DEADLINE_BEYOND_HORIZON: Calculated deadline exceeds the calendar horizon

validation.targetRange: Converted target must be between 1 and {{max}} minutes.
validation.touchesRange: Enter a whole number between 1 and 50.
validation.complianceRange: Enter a percentage greater than 0 and up to 100.
validation.backdated: Effective date cannot be in the past.
validation.minutesInvalid: Enter a positive whole number of minutes.
validation.fromInvalid: Select a valid start date and time.
validation.minutesRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
